titulo: Three ways to say it's Friday
caption:
Three ways to say it's Friday

I used to let a wrong day slide to avoid a fuss. Then I started saying Friday, I think.

A small mistake caught early costs one sentence, and the same mistake caught late can cost a whole plan.

For whoever fixes a small mistake gently.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A lavender room with a bed on the right and a plum figure that says see you Thursday! in each of three labeled scenes. The nod: a teal figure says yep, bye! and looks down, trembling. The gotcha: a brown figure squints and says wrong. Friday. while the plum one looks away. The soft fix: an ink-black figure tilts its head and says Friday, I think., and the plum one answers with happy eyes. The text stays: three kinds of correcting someone. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
